changelog: Fix fail-open contradictions in the guard guidance. (1) Troubleshooting told readers to 'serialize before testing' — the exact shape the body proves refuses only 3/6 hostile values; now prescribes type-check-first (6/6). (2) The 'Placeholder with no value' fix contradicted Rule 2's removal test and silently un-did scope cuts. (3) Sentinel gate scope was ambiguous between config and context — the shipped example's INSTALL_HOME sentinel exploited the gap; gate now walks both blocks. (4) Added the missing warn/strict two-mode spec that three hard gates already referenced. (5) INSTALL_HOME could never satisfy the no-sentinel hard gate in documented CLI-arg mode. (6) Fixed dead xref to Gotchas and a wrong 'next row' reference. (7) MEMORY.md and README.md were audited but absent from the anatomy tree. (8) requires.bins omitted node. (9) Scoped the *.bak-* .gitignore claim to what it actually covers. (10) Example questionnaire violated its own ASCII-only rule in a rendered value.
summary: Replicate one agent across N clients without drift — one context source, a generator that refuses unknowns. Use when duplicating an agent deployment. Trigger...
